source.name: Open Climate Risk v1.1.0 (CarbonPlan), fire-risk tensor
source.years: bp_2011 and rps_2011 are ~2011 conditions; bp_2047 and rps_2047 are ~2047 conditions

derived: Values sampled from OCR by Grounding; NaN cells (unburnable) are left out of the statistics.

buildingSite.location: BDG2 site coordinates of site Bear (site-level, not the building)

earthScene.selection: OCR cells whose centres fall inside the scene footprint

attribution: Open Climate Risk v1.1.0, CarbonPlan, CC BY 4.0, https://source.coop/carbonplan/carbonplan-ocr; values sampled by Grounding.
Burn probability: Riley et al. 2025, USDA Forest Service Research Data Archive RDS-2025-0006, https://www.fs.usda.gov/rds/archive/catalog/RDS-2025-0006
Risk to potential structures: Scott et al. 2024, RDS-2020-0016-2, https://www.fs.usda.gov/rds/archive/catalog/RDS-2020-0016-2
Wind adjustment: CONUS404, Rasmussen et al., https://doi.org/10.5066/P9PHPK4F
limitations: Modelled values for national or relative comparison, not a locally calibrated assessment (Scott et al.).
Context, not evidence: one location per case; the values do not test or change either case's result.
